elements.name: Mars
elements.text: Mars: direct, assertive action, jolting stagnant energy into motion.

elements.name: Lightning bolt
elements.text: The lightning strike that splits the tower open: the sudden change that forces movement, however unwelcome it arrives.

elements.name: Falling figures
elements.text: The two figures cast from the tower: falling not as ruin but as release, riding the wave of change instead of resisting it.
